subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should #38327 remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue?
rationale: The active PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack path touches provider auth, dependency policy, and close/split triage that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep #38327 canonical until both slices are resolved
options.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or repair before closing.

options.title: Split the auth-stack path now
options.body: Move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a focused follow-up and close this issue only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Override sanitizer proof only
options.body: A provider owner can accept source-level sanitizer proof, but the separate ADC reproduction still needs a durable tracker before any close.

recommendation.title: Keep #38327 canonical until both slices are resolved
recommendation.body: Review and prove the sanitizer PR first, then keep this issue open for native Vertex ADC/gaxios proof or repair before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and canonical issue triage.
